# IT-JAY

> IT Architecture, Cybersecurity, Web Development & IT Support for Small Businesses based in Belgium (Erpe-Mere / Aalst, Brussels, Ghent).

IT-JAY is an IT consulting and services firm founded by Jędrzej Dec. The company specializes in cyber awareness training, outsourced IT helpdesk/support for small businesses (SMEs/kmo's), custom web development (static and dynamic websites), cloud migration (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace), and network security (Zero-Trust VPN, firewalls).

## Core Services

- [Cybersecurity Training](https://it-jay.be/index_en.html#szkolenia): Employee awareness workshops covering phishing detection, password management, MFA, and incident response procedures.
- [IT Support & Helpdesk](https://it-jay.be/index_en.html#wsparcie-it): Ongoing and on-demand workstation maintenance (Windows/macOS), automated encrypted backups, network administration, and Microsoft 365 support.
- [Web Development](https://it-jay.be/index_en.html#strony-www): Bespoke design, high-performance static websites, and content-managed dynamic platforms.
- [Cloud & Network Infrastructure](https://it-jay.be/index_en.html#infrastruktura): Cloud migration, LAN/Wi-Fi segmentation, Zero-Trust VPN tunnels (WireGuard/IPsec), and infrastructure documentation.
